dependency_reason: The vertex branch records color presence and uses the fallback flag.
This guard clears colors when fallback is disabled and a vertex lacks color.
The configuration supports vertex_color=false but defaults to true.

dependency_reason: ParseFromString constructs streams from the supplied OBJ and MTL strings.
The local streams and material reader remain in scope during LoadObj.
LoadObj completes cleanup and transfers parsed attributes before returning.
The unchanged config value becomes LoadObj's fallback argument.
The color-clearing guard requires fallback to be false.
Colored and uncolored vertex lines set color presence and populate colors according to the fallback flag.
The required false flag and missing color trigger clearing.
The false setting is supported, while construction selects true.
ParseFromString forwards the config value to the relevant LoadObj call.
